references.title: Detecting Pretraining Data from Large Language Models
references.use: Min-K% Prob uses token likelihoods as a membership-inference signal; not a definitive membership certificate, requires suitable matched calibration data and token-level likelihood access.

references.title: Does Data Contamination Detection Work (Well) for LLMs? A Survey and Evaluation on Detection Assumptions
references.use: Some evaluated MIA assumptions perform near chance; distribution shift can confound seen/unseen comparisons. Negative detection does not certify clean data.

references.title: LiveBench: A Challenging, Contamination-Limited LLM Benchmark
references.use: Fresh sources and continually renewed objective scoring reduce contamination exposure. Use accepted conference title Contamination-Limited rather than overclaim zero risk from earlier arXiv title.

references.title: Benchmarking Large Language Models Under Data Contamination: A Survey from Static to Dynamic Evaluation
references.use: Supports separate detection/mitigation and moving from static to fresh or dynamic evaluation; no method automatically proves the unknown full training corpus clean.
